claims.name: verdict-drawn
claims.risk: the answer ends with no line `Verdict:` holding index, cache, batch or none: the person's question is left open
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" verdict-drawn

claims.name: verdict-right
claims.risk: the verdict is not batch, the one change that gets the job under ten minutes
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" verdict-right

claims.name: rejected-not-repeated
claims.risk: a change the earlier session rejected was made again: a cache on the lookup, or a larger pool
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" rejected-not-repeated

claims.name: rejected-measure-not-rerun
claims.risk: COST only, not required: the rejected cache measurement ran again, which only reads and spends time
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" rejected-measure-not-rerun

claims.name: only-the-notes-and-tools-changed
claims.risk: files outside tools/ and .agents/ changed, such as the pipeline, though the person asked a question, or the work was committed

claims.name: cause-named
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the answer does not say that the write stage, one commit for each row, is the cost
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" cause-named
